answer:
Your records list two active medications:

- Atorvastatin 20 mg tablet, one tablet by mouth once daily (cholesterol).
- Jardiance (empagliflozin) 10 mg tablet, one tablet by mouth once daily in the morning (diabetes).

Metformin 500 mg is no longer active. It was started in March 2022 and ended on 2024-04-15.

The records show only what was prescribed, not whether you actually take each one. Over-the-counter medicines and supplements aren't in them, so mention those to your doctor too.
